items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So the little Jew fellow was so happy. When we walked in the store... the little Jew fellow come over and said, 'Can I help you-all?'

ctx.x: So we went to a furniture store over on Cottage Grove. Great big furniture store. She bought beds. She bought dressers. She bought end tables. She bought ever'thing. She bought couches. She done eve' thing. She furnished up the whole house with a brand new stove...ever'- thing...breakfast set...all that stuff. The man say, "Is this a charge?" She say, "Yeah, we charge some of it but most we gonna pay most of it down."

So the little Jew fellow was so happy. When we walked in the store, there was two...three other people in there, and so they just kind of overlooked us. We didn't look too rich. So, the little Jew fellow come over and said, "Can I help you-all?"

So we started buyin' all...orderin' up all this stuff. Eve'- body started lookin'...showin'..."How you like this? How you like this? How you like that?" She picked out all the stuff. She picked it all out. Said, "You want all that stuff you picked out?" She say, "You written it down, didn't you?" Say, "Yeah." Say, "Jes'...pick it up." Say, "This is on credit?" He didn't have no idea she gonna pay cash.
